description: Example tea product files. Each tea stores arrays of term IDs from the taxonomy. Empty or missing arrays mean that category won't display.

notes.custom_terms: When you enter a term that isn't in the taxonomy, store it with a 'custom: true' flag. Example: { id: 'wet-stone-path', label: 'Wet stone path', custom: true, category: 'flavor' }. These appear in your admin with a small indicator so you can later promote them to the official taxonomy or leave them as one-offs.
notes.cross_referencing: To find all teas sharing a term, filter products where tasting[category] includes the term ID. For example, all teas with 'hui-gan': products.filter(p => p.tasting.finish?.includes('hui-gan')). This works across categories too: all 'grounding' teas, all 'amber' teas, all teas brewed in a 'gaiwan'.
notes.display_logic: On the product page, iterate over the six category keys. If the array exists and has entries, render the category label and resolve each ID to its display label from the taxonomy. If the array is empty or missing, skip it entirely. No empty states, no placeholder text.
